title: Screen ideas for buyers who pay despite free tools
ask: Change the idea screen from ap-company-1: instead of requiring that no free tool exists, require sourced proof that people pay despite the free tools, a named gap the free tools miss, and searches our own page could rank for
why: The current screen passed 0 of 25 niches in the last two cycles (company/log/research.company.json, 15 Nov 2026): almost every niche has some free tool, so the pods sat empty and nothing can earn.

options.option: Do nothing for now: keep requiring that no free tool already does the job
options.basis: 0 of 25 niches passed on 15 Nov 2026 (company/log/research.company.json), so this keeps pods empty. No honest profit figure.

options.option: Require sourced proof that buyers pay despite free tools, a named gap they miss, and searches our page could rank for; the business case gate stays as strict as now
options.basis: Research already found paid tools selling beside free ones, for example CDE BLS-2026 at USD 155 (https://www.cdesoftware.com/?p=10060) and ShowSort at USD 2.49 a show (https://www.capterra.com/p/10019014/ShowSort/). The case and sizing gates still stop weak ideas. No case has passed yet, so no honest profit figure.

options.option: Drop the screen and staff the top scored ideas as before
options.basis: Before the screen, 8 of 8 staffed ideas died at the business case for the same reason (see killReason in company/ventures/*.json), wasting pod cycles.

decision.choice: Require sourced proof that buyers pay despite free tools, a named gap they miss, and searches our page could rank for; the business case gate stays as strict as now
decision.reason: It is the only realistic option that lets an idea reach a business case at all, costs nothing, keeps the strict case and sizing gates, and is undone by reverting one charter paragraph.
